title: 观察者模式：订单变了，谁该收到通知？
style: Language-independent observer design. One in-process order17 changes pending-payment to paid, then shipped. A summary and change-log subscribe, are notified in sequence after state changes, and react independently by a common order-id plus new-status contract. Summary unsubscribes before shipped and is visibly stopped with last-received paid state. Source depends on current subscriptions and common notification contract, not response details. No code, syntax, analogies, fake windows, dense class diagrams or decorative progress. Show actual registration, state mutation, delivery, response and removal in causal order. Spoken chapter bridges precede new detail.
sampleDataLabel: 示例 · 同一程序内 · 订单17
userScope: Explain why receiver membership and response details can change independently of order state handling; current subscriptions and a meaningful notification contract; different responses to one fact; unsubscribe lifecycle and subsequent delivery to remaining receiver; scoped maintenance benefit, cost and reliable-delivery limits. Language implementation is optional article material.
discussionQuestion: 摘要取消订阅后，订单再变为已发货，谁会收到通知？订单仍依赖哪些共同约定？
